evals.prompt: I want to create a simple agent using openai-agents that can tell jokes. How do I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Code example showing how to create a basic Agent with instructions and run it using Runner.run()

evals.prompt: How do I add tools to my agent? I want to create a weather tool that the agent can call.
evals.expected_output: Explanation and code showing how to create a function tool using @function_tool decorator or FunctionTool class, and add it to an agent

evals.prompt: I need to stream responses from my agent to show real-time updates. How do I do streaming with openai-agents?
evals.expected_output: Code example showing Runner.run_streamed() usage and how to iterate over stream_events()

evals.prompt: How can I have multiple agents that hand off to each other? I want a research agent that passes work to an analysis agent.
evals.expected_output: Explanation of handoffs pattern with code showing multiple agents and the handoff() function
